name: Freedom Arrow — 0.8 (China)
description: Freedom Arrow 0.8: China (PLA) on the full 0.7.0-dev.58 game. 0.8.0-dev.33: Shawn's models (HQ-17/17A, J-20S, PLZ-05, ZTZ-96/96A, ZTL-191, ZBL-09, Z-21, Type 052D, PGL-625, PGZ-09); FBX animation offsets baked out; 0.8.0-dev.32: purchased models fixed (guns on PLL-09, PLZ-45A4, PLZ-83, PLZ-89; clear glass; Jiutian faces forward); 0.8.0-dev.31: smoother ZSL-92 surface; 0.8.0-dev.30: MD-22 Heavy strike, Godswords 100, Spike and GAM-102LR 140 penetration; 0.8.0-dev.29: 22 purchased ShuyangXi models (DF-21, DF-31A, PLZ/PCL/PLL artillery, HQ-12, PGZ-88, PTL-02, J-5/6/7, KJ-500, KQ-200, Y-8, Jiutian, WZ-7, Z-8L); 0.8.0-dev.28: QN-202 18 damage at half rate; 0.8.0-dev.27: QLU-11 almost no dispersion; 0.8.0-dev.26: QN-202 damage 9; 0.8.0-dev.25: CTL-181 missile without laser guidance; 0.8.0-dev.24: Godswords 80, QLU-11 at the full XM25 rate; 0.8.0-dev.23: darker ZSL-92 with a stronger metallic layer; 0.8.0-dev.22: conscript rifles another 30% slower, WZ-8 as an RQ-170 with MiG-31 flight; 0.8.0-dev.21: DPS-per-point price and kit pass, CH-901 rework with Blood Wolves laser, QLU-11 and QTS-11 grenade launcher tuned as XM25; 0.8.0-dev.20: launcher ammo parity, non-transports lose seats; 0.8.0-dev.19: ZSL-92 retexture pilot (woodland digital); 0.8.0-dev.18: FAModels 0.3.17 infantry body fix; ZBL-191 with HJ-16 (1500 m), APS and SRAT II armour (105); 0.8.0-dev.16: transport cleanup (no logistics vehicles, Shaanxi Troop Truck or Z-20T as squad transports, CSK-131 merged, CSK-181 in Airborne/Navy/Motorized, Chinese Lynx weapons); 0.8.0-dev.14: HJ-10 is a semi-active Hellfire that fires at spotted enemies without its own line of sight (runtime hook); CH-901 is a CTL-181-style munition. Includes the dev.8 aircraft batch and CTL-181 NLOS (8 damage, 1800 m). Needs Freedom Arrow — Models and Music 0.2.5.
